source.title: Soul of the Void
source.description: The scythe is progressing nicely. The next soul you should try adding is that of a Voidwalker. I know of a particularly powerful one that is lingering despite its master dying nearby. It should make for a good addition.
source.objective: Find the Voidwalker near Corin's Crossing in Eastern Plaguelands and add its soul to the scythe.
source.completion: Excellent, <name>. Are you ready for the next stage of restoration of this scythe?
